name:
The Legend of Zelda™:
Majora's Mask 3D
description:
Race against time and save a
doomed land in The Legend of Zelda:
Majora’s Mask 3D. In this full
remaster of the fan favourite
Nintendo 64 title, which includes
refreshed visuals and features while
remaining true to the original title,
embark on an engrossing, spooky
quest through a mysterious world.



Join Link as he seeks to save the
land of Termina from a crushing fate –
in three days, the moon will crash
down and destroy everything and
everyone in its path. By using the
magical Ocarina of Time, Link must
travel through time, re-living the same
three days over and over again, to
prevent calamity and save the world.
Explore every corner of Termina and
delve into dangerous dungeons,
across treacherous mountains,
poisonous swamps, an eerie desert
and a vast ocean, on your mission to
stop Skull Kid!
